narrative: I was charged two separate fees this month, a $15 processing fee and a $35 late fee. I think both of these are wrong and should be refunded.
extracted_allegations: Charged a $15 processing fee this month that the customer believes is wrong | Charged a $35 late fee this month that the customer believes is wrong
policy_cited: 06 Fee Waiver and Goodwill Credit Authority, 'When a waiver is NOT appropriate' (no waiver applicable: disclosed fee correctly charged; other fee not found)
draft_text:
Thank you for writing to us about the $15 and $35 charges you noticed this month. When you see fees you weren't expecting, it makes sense to want to check them, so we went through your account to look at both.

The $15 processing fee: This charge did come out of your account, on June 25, 2026. It's listed as a standard fee in section 2.1 of your loan agreement, and we didn't find an error in how it was charged. Because of that, we aren't refunding it.

The $35 late fee: We looked through your transaction history for the period and didn't find a $35 late fee anywhere on your account. Your account is also showing as current. Since that charge isn't on your account, there's nothing to refund.

If you're seeing a $35 charge somewhere, please send us the date and where you saw it, and we'll take a look. And if there's anything else you'd like us to consider about either fee, you're welcome to send it at any time and we'll review it.
